name: Joplin
summary: Note taking app with Markdown, to-dos and end-to-end encrypted sync.
description:
Joplin keeps notes and to-do lists in notebooks. Notes are written in Markdown and can hold images, attachments and tags.

It syncs through Nextcloud, Dropbox, OneDrive, WebDAV or a Joplin server, with optional end-to-end encryption, and imports Evernote exports.
